callsUsed.title: Call with Pvm Properties - Vickie Matus

Vickie, owner of PVM Properties, is looking for a more user-friendly solution for their 340-bed student housing property in Waco, Texas, and potentially for their other properties (single-family homes, duplexes, and a small apartment complex) currently managed by AppFolio. Sabrina will connect Vickie with an Entrata sales representative for a 30-minute call next Monday to discuss specific needs, pricing, and assess if PVM Properties meets Entrata's minimum requirements, which are typically 250 units but vary for student housing.
